title: use dev-novel in dev environment
body:
**Summary**

I really liked the developper experience while using storybook for react-instantsearch. Too bad storybook is sticked to a React environment.

To achieve a similar experience, I used https://github.com/algolia/dev-novel (still private to Algolians) which will enable us to test independently the result of every widgets in a much easier way.

I'll add more use-cases of the widgets with default `SearchParameters` while doing #2193
